phases.name: Second Form
phases.say: Then see what I paid for.

say.open: You come armed into my hall. Kneel, and I may let you keep your names.

bestiary.lore: The last King of the capital, who bargained with the Unknown for a throne that would never fall. It has not.
bestiary.weakness: Holy. Do not strike him in melee while he stands on guard; his Parry answers the next blow.
bestiary.pattern: Decrees one Scion, and every Knight in the hall turns on them; duels them himself with a reaching blade, and keeps a Parry ready for the next melee blow. Beaten down, he rises in his Second Form.
